caption: The drawing depicts a rectangular textile-like object rendered with pencil on a light beige or off-white background. The object is composed of many horizontal lines of varying thicknesses and densities, some forming patterns that appear to imitate woven textures. These lines create an organized series of bands that extend the width of the rectangle, with denser or darker shading in some sections, especially at the top and bottom borders. Along the left edge of the rectangle, there is a portion with diagonal crosshatching, and a similar effect appears on the right margin. The vertical center of the rectangle is faintly marked by two closely drawn lines, dividing the form symmetrically. To the lower left side of the drawing, there is a small block of orange color alongside a handwritten annotation in pencil. The entire composition is centered on a blank background, with no additional objects or decorative elements outside the main rectangular form and the noted annotation.
title: Textile
